# NEVERMERGE: one current-Q onboarding experiment

This source is preparation, not Root execution/platform admission. It is a
single `Q04c-on-Pff8/T7013 onboarding` experiment. It is not a prefix497/520/542
binary run, Auth648 verification, final integrated Native or ALL-348 acceptance.
The old ALL-354 goal stays blocked. No retry is supplied. Preserve the four
historical failed Q cases, actual consumed SDK-only PASS and lifecycle531 spent1.

`pair.json` freezes the supplier tuple. H15d is an external tool checkout with
the provisional P/Q integration and inherited **unmerged Auth648 fb6**; this
controller does not build or execute that H's Rust/OAuth/MCP source. P is the
genuine full14/T7013 package child ff8, not a three-prefix-only product. The
controller itself is based on dev a86. No whole9/14 restack or product copy is
needed. The SDK2cee Bound/ci.run adapter is reused with the distinct proposed
23-minute runtime envelope; the previous SDK allocation is already consumed.

Only `ci_startup.run_case(scenario='onboarding')` is selected. Its maintained
normal-package/relocation admission, actual configuration and environment
resolver, generated actual runner, OwnerWitness, LiveAudit, existing console
and authorization observations, result/JSON/PNG/integrity and positive cleanup
remain owning behavior. Build-for-testing is still <=240s and test-without-building
<=300s, both clamped to the same original work deadline. Helper and locked setup
commands use the same clock and ci.run process-group/drain/ownership mechanism.
The callback changes to the original cleanup reserve after test completion or
helper failure. The maintained case cleanup runs without renewing work time.
There is no qualify/default four-case loop, R executable, futureStore, private345,
settings/TCC/grant/sleep-wake operation, signing or product/engine build here.
The onboarding operation list being empty is not platform clearance.

## Exact outstanding gates

1. Root's original G1 bounded source verification must review this exact
   controller commit and H15d's existing affected pin integration. These pure
   controls do not replace that review or actual runtime evidence.
2. **Availability is not solved by this local commit.** H15d is local-only in
   the private control clone. Root may separately approve create-only scratch
   refs for this exact controller and H15d, after checking push routing. Neither
   ref is published here. Proposed tool ref:
   `refs/heads/codex/experimental-native342-tools-H15d`, exactly
   `15d4fbe32ce4aca9633011e720ce9b903aa678bd`; controller ref is
   `refs/heads/codex/experimental-native342-onboarding`, exactly the frozen new
   commit. Require both refs absent before creation and use an empty expected
   lease, never overwrite. No PR, merge, public9/14 update or Auth readiness
   follows. Alternatively Root must nominate an equally reviewed exact source
   transport that preserves a real clean Git checkout; a file projection must
   not bypass require_checkout or conceal Auth ancestry.
3. **Package transport remains a concrete gate.** Reuse the retained genuine
   ff8 package; this task was not supplied its local artifact path, manifest
   digest or an approved destination transport. The supported minimal handoff
   consists of the unchanged `manifest.json` and its named original
   `manifest.container.name` ZIP (normally `NAC-normal-arm64.zip`). Root must bind
   their SHA-256/size to the existing ff8 receipt and separately approve their
   transfer to the selected host. Do not upload arbitrary artifacts, rebuild,
   re-sign, manufacture a receipt or reuse the SDK invalid configuration.
   On the host, preserve these two original files in a new owned canonical
   package directory and extract the original ZIP there with `/usr/bin/ditto
   -x -k <original-container> <package-directory>`. It contains NAC.app. The
   unchanged P owner checks full inventory/modes/container/post-sign facts;
   Q's contract rechecks them before and after relocation and the case. No
   consumer signing/quarantine/minOS acceptance is inferred.
4. Root must supply a qualified actual full-Xcode arm64 Mac and a reviewed
   host launcher/dispatch recipe. No executable workflow or remote job has been
   installed by this source unit. Reuse SDK2cee's pre-checkout original-clock
   admission and bounded bootstrap/checkout/always-retention steps, with this
   envelope and source/transport bindings. Check out controller/H/P/Q into
   disjoint clean canonical roots with persist-credentials:false. All queue,
   bootstrap, checkout, transport, locked source setup and imports spend the
   same original clock. Do not assume H15d is GitHub-fetchable. The controller
   requires the frozen experimental ref, dispatch event and run_attempt=1.
5. Only after those gates, Root may issue ONE named attempt, zero retries, and
   separately authorize the current onboarding runtime category. The proposed
   maximum is 23 minutes: <=15 work, >=6 cleanup and >=2 retention reserve, all
   absolute queue-inclusive epochs. This document allocates no clock, slot or
   additional historical credit. A failed case/unknown cleanup stops and keeps
   its ownership/retained-profile evidence. No automatic next case is admitted.

## Host entry contract, only after those gates

Set `ROOT_ONBOARDING_ADMISSION` to JSON with exactly these fields:

```json
{
  "scope": "Q04c-on-Pff8-T7013-onboarding-only",
  "controller_sha": "<reviewed new 40-hex controller commit>",
  "allocation_id": "<Root named current allocation>",
  "attempt": 1,
  "retries": 0,
  "manifest_sha256": "<Root verified retained ff8 manifest SHA-256>",
  "clock": {
    "STARTED": 0,
    "WORK_DEADLINE": 0,
    "CLEANUP_DEADLINE": 0,
    "HARD_DEADLINE": 0
  }
}
```

The zeros/placeholders are deliberately unusable; this is a schema example,
not an admission. JSON validates a declaration and never grants authority.
Provide `H_ROOT`, `P_ROOT`, `Q_ROOT`, `PACKAGE_ROOT`, absent `OUTPUT_ROOT`, the
actual GitHub dispatch identity variables and full-Xcode `DEVELOPER_DIR` plus
`ImageVersion`. Use the existing repository-pinned Rust/Node bootstrap from
SDK2cee; this controller's make setup calls fetch/install locked dependencies,
not an engine build. Then run `python3 -B <controller-checkout>/.github/scripts/
native342-onboarding/one-onboarding.py` once. No arbitrary CLI argument exists.

Retain `OUTPUT_ROOT/evidence` only, bounded by the same hard deadline; it holds
the maintained case receipts, real result summary, PNG and helper ownership.
The maintained `export_evidence` filters `OUTPUT_ROOT/raw`, skips raw .xcresult
and app bundles, bounds individual/total sizes, redacts exact secret values
and records original/exported hashes. PNG bytes remain unchanged.
Do not upload the profile, HOME/store, genuine package or DerivedData as case
evidence. On failure retain local owned profiles when the maintained owner
cannot prove settlement; never delete unknown ownership. Root must personally
inspect the original PNG and current host/console/policy/config/source/cleanup
receipts before accepting the limited result. No other case follows.
